kamloops.title: Meet the 2 candidates running for office near Summerland after losing home, business to wildfire
kamloops.description: Weeks after a catastrophic wildfire levelled roughly 110 structures in the hills bordering Summerland, B.C., two candidates are standing in the ashes of their own properties asking displaced neighbours for their votes.

prince-george.title: Who's running for mayor in Dawson Creek? Councillor and businessman both seeking position
prince-george.description: The race for mayor in Dawson Creek is underway. Incumbent Coun. Kyle MacDonald and local businessman Dwaine Dilworth are both seeking to hold the position.

northwest.title: A swordfish was found on Haida Gwaii. Will more follow?
northwest.description: A University of British Columbia researcher says the finding is unusual but no longer unexpected due to warming waters worldwide, including in Canada.

southeast.title: Missing for 22 years: Frank Davis found in Kootenay River
southeast.description: For 22 years, the disappearance of Frank Davis remained an unanswered mystery for his family. Frank was 40 when he went missing from Creston, B.C.
